---
title: "Regional Economic Projection Report"
output: 
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    df_print: kable
params:
  start_time: NA
  end_time: NA
  scenario_name: NA
  assumption_active: NA
  initial_year: NA
  end_year: NA
  time_step: NA
  unit: NA
  location: NA
  years: NA
  sector_names: NA
  result_scenario: NA     # tibble hasil proyeksi skenario
  result_bau: NA          # tibble hasil proyeksi BAU
  recap_scenario: NA      # tibble rekap per tahun (skenario)
  recap_bau: NA           # tibble rekap per tahun (BAU)
  indicator_labels: NA    # named list label indikator
  linkage_before: NA      # vektor BL baseline (opsional, hanya A3)
  linkage_after: NA       # vektor BL setelah RAS (opsional, hanya A3)
  output_dir: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(scales)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

if (requireNamespace("TARegEco", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(TARegEco)
} else {
  devtools::load_all(".")
}

# Ekstrak parameter
result_scenario  <- params$result_scenario
result_bau       <- params$result_bau
recap_scenario   <- params$recap_scenario
recap_bau        <- params$recap_bau
indicator_labels <- params$indicator_labels
sector_names     <- params$sector_names
years            <- params$years
active_assumptions <- params$assumption_active

# Agregasi by year: sum semua sektor
agg_by_year <- function(df, col) {
  df |> dplyr::group_by(YEAR) |>
    dplyr::summarise(Total = sum(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Siapkan seri per indikator
build_series <- function(col) {
  b <- agg_by_year(result_bau, col) |> dplyr::mutate(Seri = "BAU")
  s <- agg_by_year(result_scenario, col) |> dplyr::mutate(Seri = "Skenario")
  dplyr::bind_rows(b, s)
}

ind_cols   <- c("GDP", "LABOUR", "INCOME", "SURPLUS", "OUTPUT")
ind_names  <- c("PDRB", "Serapan TK", "Pendapatan TK", "Surplus Usaha", "Output")

has_a3 <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions
```

# Pendahuluan

Laporan ini menyajikan hasil proyeksi ekonomi regional untuk `r params$location` dengan skenario `r params$scenario_name`. Analisis menggunakan model Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output (Hubacek & Sun, 2001) untuk memproyeksikan indikator makroekonomi regional pada periode `r params$initial_year`–`r params$end_year`.

Asumsi yang diaktifkan: `r paste(active_assumptions, collapse = ", ")`

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
descriptions <- c(
  "BAU" = "**BAU (Business As Usual)** — Baseline tanpa intervensi; hanya tutupan lahan BAU yang digunakan.",
  "A1"  = "**Asumsi 1 (Perubahan Lahan)** — Perubahan luas/distribusi tutupan lahan memengaruhi output sektor berbasis lahan.",
  "A2"  = "**Asumsi 2 (Peningkatan Produktivitas)** — Peningkatan LPC (Land Productivity Coefficient) secara bertahap menuju target.",
  "A3"  = "**Asumsi 3 (Hilirisasi)** — Restrukturisasi tabel Input-Output via RAS balancing yang mengubah struktur keterkaitan antar sektor."
)

for (a in active_assumptions) {
  if (a %in% names(descriptions)) {
    cat("- ", descriptions[[a]], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```


# Ringkasan

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Hitung agregat per indikator di tahun awal & akhir
summary_row <- function(df, col, label) {
  d <- agg_by_year(df, col)
  tibble::tibble(
    Indikator        = label,
    Nilai_Awal       = d$Total[1],
    Nilai_Akhir      = d$Total[nrow(d)],
    Pertumbuhan_Pct  = (d$Total[nrow(d)] / d$Total[1] - 1) * 100
  )
}

sum_bau <- purrr::map2_dfr(ind_cols, ind_names, ~ summary_row(result_bau, .x, .y)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Skenario = "BAU")

sum_sc  <- purrr::map2_dfr(ind_cols, ind_names, ~ summary_row(result_scenario, .x, .y)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Skenario = "Skenario")

sum_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(sum_bau, sum_sc) |>
  dplyr::select(Skenario, Indikator, Nilai_Awal, Nilai_Akhir, Pertumbuhan_Pct)

sum_all %>%
  kbl(
    caption = paste0("Ringkasan Eksekutif: Nilai Awal (", params$initial_year, 
                     ") vs Nilai Akhir (", params$end_year, ")"),
    digits = 2,
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".")
  ) %>%
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1:5, width = "auto")
```

# Perbandingan BAU vs Skenario

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(ind_cols)) {
  col   <- ind_cols[i]
  label <- indicator_labels[[col]]
  
  d <- build_series(col)
  d$Seri <- factor(d$Seri, levels = c("BAU", "Skenario"))
  
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = YEAR, y = Total, color = Seri, group = Seri)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(d$YEAR)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("BAU" = "#7f8c8d", "Skenario" = "#27ae60")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Proyeksi", label),
      x = "Tahun", y = label, color = NULL
    )
  
  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# Grid 2 kolom
gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 2)
```

# Tabel Rekapitulasi per Indikator {.tabset}

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_along(ind_cols)) {
  col   <- ind_cols[i]
  label <- indicator_labels[[col]]
  
  b <- agg_by_year(result_bau, col) |> dplyr::rename(BAU = Total)
  s <- agg_by_year(result_scenario, col) |> dplyr::rename(Skenario = Total)
  
  m <- dplyr::left_join(b, s, by = "YEAR") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      `Selisih (%)` = sprintf("%+.2f%%", (Skenario / BAU - 1) * 100)
    )
  
  # Cetak header sebagai Markdown mentah
  cat("\n\n## ", label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  # Cetak tabel sebagai HTML mentah
  cat(
    m %>%
      kbl(
        caption = paste("Rekapitulasi", label),
        digits = 2,
        format.args = list(big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".")
      ) %>%
      kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE) %>%
      as.character()
  )
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Analisis Sektoral {.tabset}

## PDRB per Sektor

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sector_summary <- result_scenario |>
  dplyr::group_by(SECTOR) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    GDP_Awal  = GDP[YEAR == min(YEAR)],
    GDP_Akhir = GDP[YEAR == max(YEAR)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pertumbuhan_Pct = (GDP_Akhir / GDP_Awal - 1) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(GDP_Akhir))

# Top 20 saja
top20 <- head(sector_summary, 20)

DT::datatable(
  top20,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Top 20 Sektor berdasarkan PDRB Akhir (Skenario)",
  options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = 'tip', scrollX = TRUE)
) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("GDP_Awal", "GDP_Akhir"), digits = 2, mark = ",") |>
  DT::formatRound("Pertumbuhan_Pct", digits = 2)
```

## Serapan Tenaga Kerja per Sektor
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
lab_summary <- result_scenario |>
  dplyr::group_by(SECTOR) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    TK_Awal  = LABOUR[YEAR == min(YEAR)],
    TK_Akhir = LABOUR[YEAR == max(YEAR)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pertumbuhan_Pct = (TK_Akhir / TK_Awal - 1) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(TK_Akhir))

top20_lab <- head(lab_summary, 20)

DT::datatable(
  top20_lab,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Top 20 Sektor berdasarkan Serapan Tenaga Kerja Akhir",
  options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = 'tip', scrollX = TRUE)
) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("TK_Awal", "TK_Akhir"), digits = 0, mark = ",") |>
  DT::formatRound("Pertumbuhan_Pct", digits = 2)
```

## Output per Sektor
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
out_summary <- result_scenario |>
  dplyr::group_by(SECTOR) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Output_Awal  = OUTPUT[YEAR == min(YEAR)],
    Output_Akhir = OUTPUT[YEAR == max(YEAR)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pertumbuhan_Pct = (Output_Akhir / Output_Awal - 1) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Output_Akhir))

top20_out <- head(out_summary, 20)

DT::datatable(
  top20_out,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Top 20 Sektor berdasarkan Output Akhir",
  options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = 'tip', scrollX = TRUE)
) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Output_Awal", "Output_Akhir"), digits = 2, mark = ",") |>
  DT::formatRound("Pertumbuhan_Pct", digits = 2)
```
